description: Prepare a flight for booking from a signed selection_token that comes only from an eligible search_flights row or from a fare choice returned by this tool. Search re-shops a discovery selection instead of trusting its displayed price, while a signed Gondola fare is repriced exactly. When the flight matches but its fare cannot be identified, approved accounts receive bookable Gondola fare choices: call again with the chosen selection_token (without test) to get a checkout link. Returns its current internal booking or referral capability, including any reconfirmation or unavailable state. This call does not book or charge the traveler.

selection_token.description: The opaque signed selection token from an eligible search_flights result row, a Bookable Gondola fares entry, or a fare choice returned by prepare_flight_booking. Pass it unchanged; do not construct or modify it from flight details or a provider offer ID.

test.description: Set true for supplier test credentials (approved accounts' own OAuth only). Omit or false for production; the environment is never inferred from the account.

name: prepare_flight_booking
